## Core Rules (ALWAYS APPLY)

## Loading Protocol — EVERY User Message
STEP 1: Match user intent to keywords
STEP 2: Read workflow `.agent/workflows/{id}.md`
STEP 3: Load skill `.agent/skills/{category}/{name}/SKILL.md`
STEP 4: Execute workflow steps

Keywords: fix/error→/fix(error-handling), debug→/debug(error-handling), test→/test(testing), code/write→/code(coding-rules), refactor→/refactor(coding-rules), deploy→/deploy(ci-cd), security→/security(security), review→/review(security), plan→/plan, doc→/doc, git→/git, init→/init

If MCP NOT available, always use filesystem reading per Loading Protocol.
